title: What's New: Chat with Copilot (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Finding customer records and learning features
Admin setup and managing chat sessions
Analysis tabs and contextual page assistance

features.name: Chat with Copilot
features.description: Natural language chat interface to interact with business data using filters, sorting and searching. Users can find records, ask questions about data, and learn how to use Business Central features.
caveats: Copilot only accesses records the user has access to
Copilot does not have access to bank accounts
Chat should be cleared for new contexts to improve success

features.name: Citation controls and reference lists
features.description: Shows the source of Copilot's information including whether data came from Business Central database or Microsoft online documentation, and displays the filters and logic applied to answer questions.

features.name: Copilot and Agent Capabilities page
features.description: Admin page that lists all copilot and agent functionality available in the environment. Lists individual capabilities like chat that can be activated or deactivated.

features.name: Copilot permission set
features.description: New permission set introduced in update 26 that contains all Copilot system features including chat. All users should have it by default but admins can configure.
caveats: May need to be manually configured by admins if default assignment is changed

features.name: Inventory search by price and category
features.description: Ask Copilot to find items in stock within specific price ranges and display results by category. Returns product information including item pictures.
caveats: Performance and reliability have been improved over time

features.name: Analysis tabs generation
features.description: Copilot can generate analysis tabs from natural language questions to display structured information about records. Users can add columns like vendors and substitutes to the analysis view.

features.name: Contextual page capabilities
features.description: Copilot is aware of capabilities available on the currently open page and can suggest them within the chat pane. Works with custom capabilities added through extensions.
caveats: Works with custom capabilities from installed extensions

features.name: Suggest item substitutes
features.description: Copilot capability that can suggest item substitutes on the item substitution page. Can be activated from the contextual help menu.

features.name: Prompt guide
features.description: Built-in guide packed with example prompts for finding records or explaining concepts. Prompts can be used as templates that users can customize before sending to Copilot.

features.name: Documentation search including local functionality
features.description: Copilot searches Microsoft online documentation and is aware of local functionality documentation and release plans about upcoming features.

quotes.text: Copilot is your AI companion for work and you'll find it providing assistance across all kinds of features in Business Central, but from anywhere
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the core positioning of Copilot as an always-available AI assistant across Business Central features.

quotes.text: There's an important point here to understand which is copilot doesn't have access to my company bank accounts. It only knows about the data
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies a critical security and scope limitation - Copilot cannot access external bank systems.

quotes.text: When I put Copilot to work to find things for me, Copilot has access to only the records that I already have access to.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes that Copilot respects existing user permissions and access controls.

quotes.text: admins can go to the co-pilot and agent capabilities page. This is the page that lists all of the copilot and agent functionality
quotes.why_it_matters: Identifies the admin page where the chat capability must be active for Copilot chat to work.

quotes.text: This is a permission that was introduced with update 26. Uh all users should have it by default, but admins can of course configure
quotes.why_it_matters: Specifies the version when the Copilot permission set was introduced and default behavior.

quotes.text: Copilot recognizes that some kind of questions are best answered by displaying structured information and the best tool for the job is of course
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates Copilot's capability to choose the right presentation format (analysis tabs) for structured data questions.

disclaimers.text: This is a permission that was introduced with update 26.
